name: find_references
description: Where the symbol on a line of a file is used, by a language server (Rust, TypeScript and JavaScript, Python, Go): each as `path:line:col: the source line`, sorted, a page of at most 100 (the last line says `[more: ... offset=N]` or `[end: ...]`); at most 2000 are collected and the rest is counted. Give the `line` (from 1) and the `symbol` on it, and `occurrence` when it is there more than once; `include_declaration` (default true) lists the definition too. A first call on a project starts the server and may wait for it to index (`wait` seconds, 1 to 120, default 30). Nothing is changed. Example: {"path":"src/main.rs","line":12,"symbol":"parse_config"}

path.description: The file, relative to the worktree root

symbol.description: The text on that line the position is at (a name)

occurrence.description: Which one when the symbol is on the line more than once, from 1 (default 1)

include_declaration.description: List the definition among the references (default true)

repo.description: The slot the file is in: its name, or the repository's address. Leave out when the workspace has one.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a server that is still indexing, 1 to 120 (default 30)
